leadText: Ben (Japanese: ナツヤ Natsuya) is the male player character in Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs. His female counterpart is .
plainText:
Ben (Japanese: ナツヤ Natsuya) is the male player character in Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs. His female counterpart is .

==Appearance==
Ben is a young boy with a fair skin tone, gray eyes, and brown hair. His attire features a ranger uniform where both the shirt and shorts are royal blue. Additional equipment include a yellow scarf surrounding his neck, a red sleeveless jacket with yellow trim linings, and royal blue gloves on both hands. His footwear consist of red, white, and blue casual shoes with short yellow socks.

==In the games==
Ben is a that is sent to Oblivia in order to investigate the Pokémon Pinchers. His friend and partner is , with whom he teams up with in most of his missions. If chosen by the player, he will be partnered with a ukulele-wielding Pichu. If the player chooses Summer, however, his partner will be a .

===Pokémon the Series===
====Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (animated special)====
 
Ben debuted in Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (Part 1), where he attempted to stop the Pokémon Pinchers from gaining control of a . However, he was eventually attacked during his mission by Red Eyes, and he crash-landed on Dolce Island where he captured a Ukulele Pichu.

In Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (Part 2), Ben flew over to Rasp Cavern on Renbow Island to disrupt the Pinchers' attempts to steal a Ranger Sign. While Red Eyes and his crew escaped with the Sign, Ben managed to free a in the process. He chased after the fleeing Pokémon Pinchers, and they were all confronted by a more daunting opponent, .

====Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl====
 
Ben made his debut in Pokémon Ranger: Heatran Rescue!, where he was assigned to bring a rare that knows to the National Park for its own safety. His first attempt was interrupted by 's RoboDiglett, and he lost his Capture Styler as a result. The Rocket trio later found the device and plotted to use it capture the Heatran for themselves.

Meanwhile, Ben encountered and after falling into a river, and he enlisted their help with his mission. Using the increase in ground temperature as a guide, Ben lead them up a mountain and through a cave system, where they soon encountered the special Heatran. Team Rocket appeared again, but the nabbed Capture Styler failed to operate as it was synchronized with Ben. The trio resorted to their RoboDiglett, but the unfolding battle caused the cave system to begin collapsing. Eventually, with the help of Ash's group, he managed to capture Heatran via his Capture Styler and helped it escape to safety.

===Character===
Ben is remarkably optimistic even in the most difficult of situations. He attributes his positive outlook to his grandfather, who encouraged him to give everything a go. Ben is also highly knowledgeable and uses his field experience, such as feeling the ground for increasing heat to locate in Pokémon Ranger: Heatran Rescue!.

==Trivia==
 
An alternate coloration of Ben was featured in an official artwork that featured multiplayer mode. The Ranger has dark brown hair, orange goggles, and an orange-and-green Ranger uniform. The artwork is featured on the back of the Guardian Signs game case.
